name: NEET UG
intro: The NEET UG form asks for a passport-size photo, a postcard-size photo, your signature and thumb impressions of both hands.

documents.label: Passport-size photo
documents.caption: optional
notes: White background, face covering about 80% of the photo with both ears visible.

documents.label: Postcard-size photo
documents.caption: optional
notes: 4 × 6 inch photo with a white background.

documents.label: Signature
notes: Black ink on white paper. Signatures in capital letters are not allowed.

documents.label: Thumb impression (left and right)
notes: Make one file for each hand: run the tool once for the left thumb and once for the right.

source.label: Summary of the NEET UG 2026 information bulletin (coaching-site summary, check neet.nta.nic.in)

faqs.q: What is the NEET photo size?
faqs.a: Both the passport-size and postcard-size photos must be JPG between 10 KB and 200 KB, with a white background.

faqs.q: What is the NEET signature size?
faqs.a: JPG between 4 KB and 30 KB, in black ink on white paper.
